question: The length of the diagonals of a rhombus are (y + xy + 5) m and (y − xy + 7) m respectively. Find the area of the rhombus, if x = 2 and y = 1
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly substitute **x = 2** and **y = 1** into the diagonal expressions.

d₁ = (1 + 2×1 + 5) = **8 m**

d₂ = (1 − 2×1 + 7) = **6 m**

Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ = (1/2) × 8 × 6 = **24 m²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First diagonal (d₁) = (y + xy + 5) m

Second diagonal (d₂) = (y − xy + 7) m

Values: **x = 2**, **y = 1**

**Formula Used:**

Area of Rhombus = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/038155b806a36920149690cb7af633a539c30f7cd384f07290f1bd0fae720b88.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ d₁ = 1 + (2 × 1) + 5

⇒ d₁ = 1 + 2 + 5 = 8 m

⇒ d₂ = 1 − (2 × 1) + 7

⇒ d₂ = 1 − 2 + 7 = 6 m

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 8 × 6

⇒ Area = 4 × 6 = 24 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rhombus

All **four sides** are equal, and **diagonals** bisect each other at **90°**.

Side and Diagonal Relationship

4 × (side)² = d₁² + d₂². This is derived from the **Pythagoras Theorem** in the internal triangles.

Perimeter of Rhombus

Perimeter = 4 × side. If only diagonals are known, side = (1/2) × √(d₁² + d₂²).</p
